contracts.task_type: Evaluate and execute customer refund requests
contracts.escalation_rule: Escalate to a human reviewer when daily fleet spend exceeds the ceiling; individual tasks above per-task cap are paused, not auto-approved.

contracts.task_type: First-pass review of KYC document packets
contracts.escalation_rule: Throttle to 50% throughput at 80% of the daily ceiling; stop at the ceiling and route remaining packets to the manual queue.

contracts.task_type: Assemble evidence packets for flagged transactions
contracts.escalation_rule: Never stop mid-investigation; page the fincrime on-call when spend passes the ceiling and finish open cases at reduced concurrency.

contracts.task_type: Match supplier invoices to purchase orders and ledger entries
contracts.escalation_rule: Warn the owning team at 75% of the daily ceiling; hard-stop the fleet at the ceiling — reconciliation is never time-critical.

contracts.task_type: Classify and route inbound support messages
contracts.escalation_rule: Warn the owner at 75% of the daily ceiling; throttle to half throughput at 90%; never stop fully — fall back to keyword routing.
